notes.title: The closed beta test of the "Shadow of the Council" expansion starts!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/8d54cdcf3ad4c6c11d4177ef6b954b89ff66d272.png[/img]

Star Crusaders!

08.23.17 at 05.00 PDT the closed beta test of the "Shadow of the Council" expansion starts!

We will test new game mechanics "Link", as well as over 100 new cards!
Only players who have pre-ordered "Shadow of the Council" pack or 50 "Council" boosters will be able to participate in the closed beta-testing.

To take part in the CBT you need to send a request with your game username and email address to support@starcrusadeccg.com.

When your request is confirmed, you will receive the instructions to access the test server.

The participants of the testing will be able to create bug-reports using the "Report a bug" function. Also, each player can send feedback on all aspects of the add-on. To do this, please, use the "Leave Feedback" function.

The authors of the most detailed bug-reports and reviews have a chance to get an additional reward for their main account!

Attention! All the achievements on the test server will not be transferred to the main account.

Thank you for your support! See you in orbit!

notes.title: A big content update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/68cc5fbaa9cc855af8c5dc6d477204b2b99bb4b8.jpg[/img]

Star Crusaders!

In August 2017, we plan to release a large content add-on with more than 70 new cards – Shadow of the Council!

With the release of new cards, a new type of booster – Council, containing all the new additional cards will appear in the game. You can purchase a booster of the new type once a day using credits. The price of boosters in fracta currently stays the same.

The Vraxian booster will be removed from the game. All cards from the Vraxian add-on are available in the Core booster. If at the time of the update you have leftover Vraxian boosters, they will be converted to Core boosters.

The cost of boosters in Star Crusade has remained unchanged since the release of the project. During this time, we have added multiple new ways of obtaining credits and other game assets: Exploration mode, free Crates and Daily login bonuses. That is why, with the addition of Council booster, we made a decision to revise their cost. After the update, a Core booster will cost 200 credits, and Council booster - 300 credits. While the add-on is underway, booster prices may change.

New cards from the add-on will be available for creation for scrap with increased cost.

This list of upcoming changes is not complete. Follow the news.

See you in orbit!

notes.title: New feature in the game - Animated Cards!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/8a397746cba730559b4411114ac9489312d0ade6.gif[/img]

Star Crusaders!

With the next update, you will have the opportunity to make some of your cards animated, as well as change the color of their frames!

Animated cards FAQ.

How to make a regular card animated?
1. You must have at least one copy of an upgradable card
2. You can modify the card in the deckbuilder. To do this, you need to go to the "Enhanced" tab and select the necessary card:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/8a57386bc69cbcdcc6b1bcdaab848dd2a4f9d7bc.png[/img]

3. You can change your card frame to gold with fracta or to other colors using special items:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/f1ed4a2b2bde927842ba0a73fa73d44adfe872c2.png[/img]

4. These items can be found in daily bonuses and crates:
• Common crate - 1 item of paint of random color
• Elite crate - 2 items of paint of random color
• Paragon crate - 3 items of paint of random color

Important:
• When you change the color of a regular card, it is replaced with an animated card
• If you have several identical cards, you can color each of them with a unique color
• You can color the card more than once, but the paint that you applied earlier will be lost

The required number of items for coloring cards of varied rarity:
• Elite - 3 items
• Heroic - 4 items
• Paragon - 5 items

Price for coloring cards in gold:
• Elite - 100 fracta
• Heroic - 125 fracta
• Paragon - 150 fracta

With the release of Update 1.3, the following cards will be available for upgrade: Titan, Material Defender, Horror of the Shade, Fleet Beacon, The Manovar, Carbonic Protector, The Restless, Soul Devourer, Replicant, Preacher

See you in orbit!

notes.title: What is Fracta?
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/32ca9eaacd5957b7fd49e1340dc8168b8d54ad9c.png[/img]

Fracta is a precious resource, harvested methodically, and in the face of great peril, by the Vraxxian Clans over many centuries... but for us Star Crusaders, it is a new in-game currency, which you will use to acquire many awesome new (and existing) things throughout the game!

How can you get Fracta?

• Complete weekly missions (new mission are coming soon)!
• Find it in "Exploration" mode!
• Earn it from season rewards!
• Watch rewarded videos from your mobile devices!

Of course, the best way to get Fracta while supporting Star Crusade development directly is to buy it from the in-game store! :)

Star Crusade has always been very friendly to F2P players, and that will continue to be the case – you will still be able to use credits to buy boosters, raid tickets, and weekly cards. In the future, we will expand the different ways you could spend your credits in game.

We've also got a lot of awesome game features coming soon, and we will be adding new ways to get and spend Fracta with the coming updates.

Thanks for your support and we will see you in orbit!

notes.content:

Thank you very much!

notes.title: Star Crusade -- A Balancing Act
notes.content:
Hello, dear Star Crusaders!

I wanted to let you know that we are aware of the balancing issues that are currently happening throughout the game. We are working on a hotfix today of the main module currently responsible for the havoc -- the Terran Tactical Flexibility module -- as well as the Annunaki Ethereal Enlightment module.

We are also doing another update at the end of this week, which will include more detailed fixes, such as capping the maximum energy level at 40 and bringing the much-needed ENERGIZE mechanic to 16 cards. That update will also include several fixed and rebalanced cards, as well as tweaked module costs.

Finally, I wanted to give you some idea of what to expect in the coming weeks:
- new free starting modules for every faction
- a hyper vigilant approach to imbalanced modules (since they have a powerful and immediate effect on the game)
- rebalanced conditions for passive modules, and tweaked costs for energy modules, as well as cards with ENERGIZE mechanic 
- full (and bonus!) buyback compensation for those modules that were crafted by you and then tweaked by us!

As we continue to implement new features and improve existing ones, we want to assure you that game balance remains extremely important to us -- and though we may not get it right the first time, we will continue working on it until Star Crusade is as balanced as possible. 

To thank you all for your support, we have prepared a relief pack to help you weather the storm of missing missions and other bugs that pop up from time to time. Enter the promo code [b]HardTimes[/b] in the settings menu (before this Friday) to get immediate access to the goods -- and feel free to share this code with your friends.

Thank you for your support and your patience -- we really appreciate you guys!

- Star Crusade team

notes.title: Star Crusade -- Modules and Big Balance Update! -- V1.0.1.13.S.712
notes.content:
Hello once again, fellow Star Crusaders -- we've got a BIG update for you today! :)

=> We're proud to present to you our new Module system! Each faction will have its own modules, and each deck can have between 1 and 3 modules. Modules can be passive, which means that they will affect the game during the entire match as long as their requirements are met. Other modules can instead be activated by paying the appropriate supply cost or energy cost.

Energy is the new resource that we've added to Star Crusade. Both players start the game with 0 energy, and energy can be gained using the following methods:

1) Destroying enemy units (gain energy equal to the supply cost of the destroyed enemy unit)
2) Removal of enemy weapon (gain energy equal to the supply cost of the removed weapon)
3) Dealing damage to enemy commander (gain 1 energy for each time damage is dealt)
4) Through cards and tactics that affect energy
5) Each unused module slot generates 1 energy for its controller at the end of each turn

It is important to note that energy is not connected with the number of turns: starting or ending a turn has no effect on energy.

=> Each faction has two base modules: one that is available instantly (this was previously the commander ability) and one that becomes available when you reach level 15 for each faction commander. In total, over fifty modules are available now!

=> We've also added over 30 new unit and tactic cards to the game!

=> The following huge list of balance changes has been integrated into the game:

notes.title: Star Crusade -- Orbital Status Update
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Star Crusaders!

We've all been very busy here working on what seems like an endless list of features, bug fixes and improvements and I wanted to take some time to update you all on what exactly is happening in the Star Crusade universe. I'll try to make an update like this every weekend so we can keep the discussion going -- but this first one is going to be a big one, since there's a lot to talk about. 

So, here we go -- these are the things we are currently working on:

1) Modules:
We are integrating the modules for all the factions now; that includes working on the new gameplay and deck user interface, creating the new module illustrations, as well as implementing and tweaking the modules themselves. Each faction will have around 7-8 modules to choose from, and each deck can include anywhere from 1 to 3 modules, so the possibilities are already very extensive. We will also likely be releasing new modules in future expansions. It's been a long time coming, but I really think you're going to like the result -- I can't wait for you to make your own custom decks using these modules.

2) iPad support: 
The other big project we've been working on is iPad (and future iPhone) support. We will be demoing the game for the press at the Game Developers Conference in San Francisco in March, and we need it to look and feel right. On top of that, we need to implement a way to allow a user to register for the game outside of Steam (on iPad) and then to allow that user to merge profiles into one account -- since Star Crusade will be fully cross-compatible, allowing you to play from your PC or iPad using the same account.

3) Balance:
We are also working on a large balance patch, which will include dozens of cards -- no faction will be left untouched, including neutral cards, and even some Paragons will be updated (I talked about some of these in our last developer interview). We also don't exactly know what's going to happen once all you fine people get your hands on the modules, so we may do another balance patch shortly after the modules are released, to address any big unforeseen balance problems.

4) Leaderboards:
We've expanded the functionality of leaderboards, and there will be five divisions, with 100 players each. Each player will be able to track his standing, wherever he is in the leaderboards, and there will be additional rewards for climbing ranks and reaching new divisions.

5) Deck sharing and importing:
This is another feature we're very excited about -- the ability to share your decks with friends or even post to the global Star Crusade database. You will have the ability to view the newest or most popular decks, browse by faction, by type of deck, or even by deck size. Then, with the click of a button, you will be able to import the deck into your own collection. Any missing cards will show up marked in the imported deck, so you can immediately decide whether you want to create or replace the needed cards. Try out popular (or strange) new decks or just use it as a starting point in your own deck creation! 

6) GDC and PAX East show planning:
We're going to have a booth at the upcoming San Francisco Game Developers Conference on March 14th through 18th -- come join us if you're in the area -- and there is a lot to prepare. We're hoping to make a splash during GDC as we get ready for simultaneous release of the game on PC and iOS. 

We're also going to have a big presence at PAX East in Boston this year -- April 22nd through 24th! We're hoping to put together some fun for the showgoers and maybe set up a live stream from the event... also a lot to prepare. :)

A few words about our update schedule: the reason why we haven't been able to roll out the updates and fixes that we've been working on piece by piece is because everything is intertwined and heavily in development. We want to get it into your hands in good condition, so we have to test the interlocking pieces thoroughly -- separately and together. Also, we finally switched over to Unity 5 and there was a ton of work dealing with artifacts and corrections from that upgrade.

We're hoping to have most of this stuff ready before GDC, and I will keep you better updated with our progress. Thank you very much for your patience and your support as we continue development -- we appreciate it!

PS: Season three of Star Crusade ranked play is ending at 11:00 PM PST on February 29th, 2016 (10:00 AM MSK on March 1st). I will make a separate announcement regarding the season rewards.

Thanks again, and see you in orbit!

notes.content:
Hi guys! The new update actually hit yesterday, but since the patch notes were available from within the game itself, I actually forgot to post it here separately. 

[b]We are also aware of the bugs that are currently popping up throughout the game; we've rolled out a few hotfixes, and will continue to address these issues this week until all the new bugs are squashed![/b] Thank you for your patience while we roll out these hotfixes!


Meanwhile, here is the change log from the latest patch (apologies for the delay):

New Additions:
 - New Card Backs have been added: select the card back you want to play with in the settings menu
 - Black list: users can now be banned from sending messages, friend and duel requests
 - System notifications: user notification of critical events or communication for troubleshooting purposes
 - AFK Mode: if a player is absent from the game for a turn, his next turn will be reduced to 15 seconds; after 3 such turns, the AFK player automatically surrenders

Changes and Updates:
 - Added hints when searching for match
 - New written emotes for commanders
 - Changes in the tutorial:
  - bot deck has been changed
  - settings menu available for access during tutorial 
  - the ability to cancel or skip the tutorial at any time

 - Players' ranks are hidden in raid mode
 - Fusion mode is now available directly when editing your deck 
 - Icons in the history will now be located under the cards (instead of on top of the text)
 - The chat window will now remain open when switching between different screens
 - When in a match with a big rank disparity, the player with the lower rank has a bonus in changing ranks after a win
 - The ability of the Anunnaki commander can now be used on target unit to reduce that unit by 1 attack

Fixes:
 - "Elite" achievement has been fixed
 - Doppelganger now copies abilities of cards after attacking, not before
 - Delay when playing the "initiative" card is corrected
 - Bloodsworn Berserkers and Syndicate Enforcers no longer inflict damage on destroyed units
 - The description of the card "Pulse Barrage" has been udpated: now, it says "if you have three or more  units in the field, inflict 2 damage to each enemy character. If not, inflict 1 damage"
 - Corrected a bug, where Deflector Shield Operational would not activate if the attacked unit did not deal damage back
 - A bug where some cyphers were not considered tactics was fixed      
 - The description of some cards and abilities corrected

notes.title: Star Crusade Update -- Balance & Other Changes -- Thursday, January 7th
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've rolled out a new patch, which includes new missions, many card and bug fixes, as well as a big chunk of balance changes -- please see the details below. As always, thank you all for your continued support and for playing Star Crusade! :) 

[b]Changes: [/b]
- added many, many new missions! (*first to post on the forums about each new completed mission gets a special bonus from me*)
- lots of updates to card text (please keep sending those bug reports and feedback/suggestions!)

[b]Fixes:[/b] 
- Photonic Pylons no longer deploys with a phantom, non-working shield
- Mutating enemy Shan'Ti commander no longer gives that commander +2 attack on their turn
- EMP Blast can now be played on friendly units
- Disrupt Communications no longer works on weapons
- Mutagenic Growth now destroys friendly aberration at the beginning of your next turn, and not at the end of current turn
- Adrenal Overload and Entropic Organism now lower a unit's current and maximum health
- Baseline Menial can't transform into itself
- Espionage, played on an enemy unit, will now correctly draw the tactic owner's cards

[b]Balance changes:[/b] 
- Adrenal Overload: gives a unit +4/-1 (down from +4/-2) and costs 2 supply (up from 1).
- Advanced Fabrication: supply cost is now 3 (up from 2).
- Arms Merchant: supply cost is now 5 (up from 4).
- Battle Tactician: supply cost is now 2 (down from 3); attack is now 2 (down from 3).
- Carapace Armor: supply cost is now 3 (up from 2).
- Chimera: attack is now 5 (down from 6).
- Combat Engineer: stats changed to 1/2 (from 0/4).
- Command Promotion: supply cost is now 1 (up from 0).
- Deflector Shield Operational: only activates from friendly unit being attacked (previously activated from any damage to friendly unit).
- Duskwind Guerrilas: stats changed to 2/2 (from 3/3).
- Eridani Patrol: now belongs to "general" type (was "support" type previously).
- Espionage: supply cost is now 2 (up from 1).
- Fen-Fire: now belongs to "general" type (was "support" type previously).
- Financier: supply cost is now 5 (down from 6).
- Gargoyle Bomber: now belongs to "general" type (was "support" type previously).
- Infected Militia: now belongs to "aberration" type (was "general" type previously).
- Lieutenant: supply cost is now 6 (up from 5), stats changed to 5/4 (from 5/5).
- Mobile Base Ship: supply cost is now 4 (down from 5), health changed to 4 (from 5).
- Mutagenic Growth: now adds 5 attack to target aberration (used to double attack).
- Nightmarish Visage: now lowers attacking unit's attack by 5 (up from 4).
- Nyx Hound: health is now 1 (down from 2).
- Oculus: health is now 4 (down from 5).
- Ordinance Specialist: health is now 1 (down from 2).
- Precognition: supply cost is now 2 (down from 3).
- Pulse Barrage: supply cost is now 4 (up from 3).
- Pulse Rifles: supply cost is now 4 (up from 3).
- Raging Tide: supply cost is now 7 (up from 6).
- Recycling Vats: supply cost is now 4 (up from 3).
- Reinforce: supply cost is now 3 (up from 2).
- Rocket Batteries: supply cost is now 2 (up from 1).
- Saturate Fire: now deals 2 and 1 damage (down from 2 and 2 damage).
- Signal Ops: health is now 2 (up from 1).
- Spine Spitters: can only be played now if there is an aberration under the player's control on the field.
- Symbiotic Thrall: supply cost is now 6 (up from 5), health is now 2 (down from 3).
- Titan: supply cost is now 7 (down from 8).
- Tough Hide: supply cost is now 2 (up from 1).
- Vraxxian Gunboat: health is now 4 (down from 5).


Make sure to check out our top players' streams here:
Chesspieceface @ [url=http://www.twitch.tv/chesspieceface]http://www.twitch.tv/chesspieceface[/url]
ZOD @ [url=http://www.twitch.tv/zodrot]http://www.twitch.tv/zodrot[/url]

Big thanks to Chess and ZOD for your dedication to the game! 

Chesspieceface was also kind enough to offer me an opportunity to join him on the stream for a live Q&A Star Crusade session, so stay tuned for that announcement -- hopefully, you can join us there next week!


As always, please continue to post your thoughts and suggestions about the game in the forums -- remember, we need your input to make Star Crusade the best game it can be! Thank you!

notes.title: 1.0.0.22 Update -- Thursday, December 31st -- Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Happy New Year, fellow Star Crusaders!

We've rolled out an update to deal with a few of the most requested changes, just in time for the big New Year's celebration! :)

As always, thanks to all our players for your support and patience! Please see the change log below:

Changes: 
- you now get 3 bonus cards for finishing every raid, regardless of the outcome!
- more rewards for capturing planets!
- much higher chance for rare cards when composing raid team!
- you can now browse your raid trophies, including cards won, during each raid
* (share your heroic card drops from Raid on the forums and get some free loot from yours truly!) *
- defeating "triple-threat" planets should now be entirely optional (not on main path)
- revised gameplay soundtrack

Fixes: 
- Hellfire Cannon is now a 3/3/2 (2 charges instead of 3 charges) and should work properly
- Council Voidliner, Shadow Operative and Mining Complex should now be working correctly
- Infiltrator should no longer be disabling the commander for the whole match (just for one turn)
- True Striker should no longer remove cyphers from the enemy commanders when attacking (but wasn't that an awesome feature, you guys?)
- Disrupt Communications should no longer cancel played weapon cards
- Nullify should now correctly clear Disable effect

The season is almost over, so get out there and climb those ranks! Thanks again, and I'll see you in orbit!

notes.title: Star Crusade 1.0.0.18 update -- Thursday, December 24th
notes.content:
Season's Greetings and Happy Holidays from the Star Crusade team!

We have rolled out a small update to alleviate some of the issues with the game right now. Thanks, everyone, for your support and patience as we continue to wage the eternal battle against bugs both galactic and microscopic in scope. Check out the change log below!

Changes:
- new sound and visual effects when opening booster packs 
 [b]==> first one to post a screenshot of a HEROIC or PARAGON card reveal effect gets two booster packs! 
 ==> first one to post a video of this effect gets three booster packs! :)[/b]
- Raid cards are now sorted by supply cost 
- ability to toggle on and off opponent's emotes (each opponent or all emotes)
- added card trigger effect during gameplay
- added "Tactic" icon to tactic cards
- added "Back" button to Fusion mode 
- added "Beta" tag to our logo on main menu

Fixes:
- fixed issue with game hanging sometimes after opening the initial tutorial booster packs
- fixed issue with being stuck on loading screen, after exiting raid mode during deck creation
- fixed other issues with being stuck on loading screen when buying a raid entrance
- fixed issue with disconnect/reconnect loop when you try to play with a deck after melting one or more cards within that deck (the decks are now properly shown after melting cards)
- fixed visual bug with credit balance increasing after spectating a victory
- first planet of each raid will not show up as captured at the beginning of the raid
- lots of corrections of typos in cards
- fixed issue with scaling of long player nicknames

I will also update the sticky topic with a list of known bugs and issues in the "Bug Reports" subforum. We're aware that the matchmaking issue is a big one right now -- we're working on it and I will let you know when to expect the update as soon as I know!

Thanks again, and I'll see you in orbit!

notes.title: 1.0.0.12 update -- Saturday, December 19th
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Our open beta has now been live for a whooping FOUR days, and I just wanted to pass along a very big "THANK YOU" from our entire development group to you, our kick-ass Star Crusaders! 

Please continue to play the game, stay active in the forums, and file those bugs -- we read EVERYTHING, even though we may not always be able to respond to that everything right away. :) 

To keep things moving, and to deal with a few issues, we rolled out a small update early this morning. Here's the (abridged) change log:

[list]
    [*] missions should now renew every 24 hours, as intended!
    [*] separated the deck-builder and crafting tutorial from the main one to allow players to get into the game faster
    [*] removed tutorial games from list of spectatable matches (turns out, it's not that fun to watch other people play the tutorial)
    [*] added a new starter mission after the tutorial
    [*] increased overall Raid rewards
    [*] fixed the majority of the disconnect/reconnect issues
    [*] fixed and enabled Steam achievements 
    [*] corrected rare glitches with "end turn" button
    [*] fixed loss of sound/music (when multi-tasking)
    [*] fixed a glitch with the "defeat a friend" mission
    [*] updated the ability glossary to explain more of the game terms/functionality properly (we know this is still NOT good enough, we are working on improving this in the next few updates)
    [*] a few minor fixes for cards and UI elements
[/list]

I've also posted a sticky topic in the Bug Reports subforum which outlines a few of the more popular, or pesky, known issues in the game at this time.

Thanks again for playing, and we'll see you in orbit!

notes.title: Star Crusade Open Beta Release!
